title: The Overgrown Pot
description: An aging botanist realizes her own life has become as root-bound as the neglected specimens in her greenhouse.
character_reference: an older woman with silver hair pulled back in a loose bun, wearing a forest-green canvas apron smeared with dark soil

scenes.narration: For four decades, Elena knew the exact watering schedule of every rare fern and succulent in the municipal conservatory. She kept them alive while her own life stood still.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a sunlit greenhouse filled with hanging ferns and tropical plants, an older woman tending to a tall monstera

scenes.narration: When she finally tried to repot a massive monstera, she found the roots spiraling tightly in circles, strangled by the ceramic walls that once protected them.
scenes.visual: close-up of thick tangled roots spilling out of a cracked terracotta pot onto a wooden potting bench covered in loose dirt

scenes.narration: She used her worn trowel to gently tease the compacted earth apart. The plant resisted at first, holding stubbornly to the shape of its confinement.
scenes.visual: close-up of gloved hands carefully pulling apart dark matted soil with a small metal garden trowel

scenes.narration: Looking down at her own calloused hands, Elena realized she had stayed in the same comfortable rut for so long that she had forgotten how to expand.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the woman pausing, staring thoughtfully down at her dirt-smudged palms while surrounded by green leaves

scenes.narration: She carried the heavy plant outside into the open courtyard, finding a larger vessel with fresh, nutrient-rich soil and plenty of room to stretch.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the woman lifting a large green plant into a spacious new unglazed pot in an outdoor sunlit courtyard

scenes.narration: Giving something room to grow meant accepting the mess of change and trusting that the new soil would hold it steady.
scenes.visual: close-up of soil being patted down gently around the base of the plant stem, dappled sunlight filtering through overhead glass panes

scenes.narration: She poured fresh water over the leaves and took her first deep breath of the afternoon air, feeling lighter than she had in years.
scenes.visual: profile shot of the woman closing her eyes and breathing out slowly as water droplets glisten on fresh green foliage

scenes.narration: Every season offers us a chance to repot our lives. Follow along for more stories of quiet transformation.
scenes.visual: portrait shot of the woman smiling warmly toward the camera against a soft background of indoor botanical plants
